recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-24110; if future authoritative external terminology registry work is required, it should be handled in THO rather than by editing the current core Code Systems page.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification request to remove accidental trailing slashes from Code Systems for Genetics URIs, conditioned on Clinical Genomics confirming no implementer impact for the R4 technical correction.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied by 2c2e2d5931, which changed the RefSeq, ClinVar, and HGVS rows in source/terminologies-systems.html to slashless forms, and by the follow-up GF#24110-tagged commit e0c3d06011. Jira also records that the fix was made in both the R4 technical correction and current build.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps the terminologies module in build scope, but the current source/terminologies-systems.html page no longer lists those genomics systems directly and delegates authoritative external code system information to THO. Zulip announcements identified the same three URI corrections and the genomics follow-up reported no feedback and no use in mCode or CG examples/bindings. Confluence searches found no relevant contrary record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit was needed because rg found no affected trailing-slash URI occurrences in current source, and current MolecularDefinition examples that use RefSeq or HGVS use the slashless URI forms.
